topic: Ivankov's lesson in chapter 1196 reframes Sanji's habit of taking hits for love as the real weakness Killingham exploits
title: Sanji's Real Weakness Was Never His Kindness
description: Chapter 1196 returns to Sanji's training with Ivankov and names the weakness Killingham keeps using. Here is why it was never about being too kind.
comment: Is Sanji's habit of taking hits a weakness or his greatest strength? Pick one.

lines.text: Sanji's real weakness was never his kindness. It was how he spent it.
In chapter 1196, Oda returns to Sanji's two years training under Ivankov in Kamabakka.

shot.fallback: flamboyant queen training a blond cook

lines.text: The lesson isn't about kicks. It's that a man who doesn't love himself can't love anyone else.

shot.fallback: teacher gently lecturing a young cook

lines.text: Sanji's habit is throwing himself in front of every hit and calling that love.

shot.fallback: cook shielding friends with his body

lines.text: Killingham spots it at once and taunts him that Conqueror's Haki will never be his.

shot.fallback: young knight with a spear sneering

lines.text: He even throws a twisted Ivankov at him.

shot.fallback: distorted queen figure looming over a cook

lines.text: Now the detail people forgot. Sanji disowned the Vinsmokes twice, chapters 870 and 903.

shot.search: Sanji Vinsmoke family Whole Cake Island
shot.fallback: cook facing his cold family of royals

lines.text: Both times he refused to be treated as a tool, and both times he chose the crew.

shot.fallback: cook turning his back on a royal father

lines.text: Call it loyalty, but loyalty with no self left makes you a human wall.

shot.fallback: cook standing alone against a huge attack

lines.text: Ivankov wasn't scolding him. Protection only counts if Sanji is still standing.

shot.fallback: cook rising slowly with a serious look

lines.text: What happens when Sanji finally believes that changes his place in this crew.

shot.fallback: cook standing in front of his crew

lines.text: And that's why the thing everyone called his weakness was never his kindness...

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim in line 1 with Sanji named.
